items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: Do you know Bob Landon? ... You've heard of him, haven't you?

ctx.x: Sometimes you get a job and sometimes you don't. That's why I went out and hustled, you know. I knew I had to get along, so I went out there and did my hustling. I was going around to different clubs at nights, sit in, play
a set, maybe two sets. Make 15, $20.00. Go to the next place, a couple doors down, you know, go right next door and play there. Do you know Bob Landon?
No, I never met Bob Laine. Landon.
